summary: Every round-1 issue is fixed. The heist lock and the telescope keep their checks, at better odds, with their risks intact. Lyra's silk is a one-time reveal. The scribe writes only to the four friends who can be away from the capital, gated on standing, on two months apart and on Ilse not being taken, and the door opens once a month. The tidewood wand no longer duplicates hazel, the curio prices are evened out, and the continuity slips are gone. The zh-CN lines are updated. One polish item remains.

issues.problem: clockwork_songbird's `price:` (what selling it pays) is medium, the same as the bazaar charges for it. Every other ware here resells for at least a tier less than it costs (the ivory dice now sell for small against a medium price). The pawn counter doesn't list the capital items yet, so this has no effect today.
issues.fix: Set clockwork_songbird `price: small`, so that it matches the dice when a pawn line is added.
